 Jensen Huang's daughter Madison Huang is a trained chef, studied cooking not engineering. How she made a career in AI and got into Nvidia
 SECTIONS Jensen Huang's daughter Madison Huang is a trained chef, studied cooking not engineering. How she made a career in AI and got into Nvidia ET Online Last Updated: Nov 16, 2026, 02:48:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Jensen Huang's daughter Madison Huang trained as a chef before building a career in luxury marketing and joining NVIDIA. At an event at Seoul National University, she revealed how her father's advice encouraged her to follow her passion for cooking instead of engineering. Today, she leads product and technical marketing for NVIDIA's physical AI platforms.
 Madison Huang, daughter of Jensen, went from culinary school and luxury branding to a senior role at NVIDIA, working on physical AI platforms.
 NVIDIA's Jensen Huang 's daughter once was preparing to be an electrical engineer, just like her mom Lori Huang and her father. Despite that, the former head of the chipmaker had different plans for his daughter. So, instead of pursuing engineering, Madison ended up training as a chef. She worked in professional kitchens and later studied fine wines, before she moved to luxury marketing and then finally joining NVIDIA. Today, she is the Senior Director of Product Marketing at NVIDIA and works on physical AI platforms . At an event, she once opened up about her unusual career journey and the advice her father gave her.
 Jensen Huang encouraged daughter Madison to follow her passion
Speaking at an event at Seoul National University (SNU)'s Robotics department, Madison revealed that she had initially prepared to study electrical engineering. However, her father asked her to reconsider her career choice and pursue her passion. Madison realised that cooking was her true passion. She withdrew her university applications and applied to the Culinary Institute of America , where she trained as a chef. She later worked in kitchens in Miami, New York and the Bay Area.
Her journey then took her to London and Paris, where she studied fine wines and spirits and trained as a sommelier. After working with luxury champagnes she moved to marketing and branding. 
 From luxury branding to a career at NVIDIA
Madison said her career might have appeared non-linear, but two principles guided her decisions: craftsmanship and attention to detail. “I always chased a profession or a craft where I was able to express or learn some element of extreme craftsmanship,” she explained. She added that she enjoyed making things with her hands and creating something she could share with others.
Before joining NVIDIA, she worked in luxury marketing and branding, including with the Louis Vuitton-Moët Hennessy Group. According to NVIDIA's website, Madison is now senior director of product and technical marketing for the company's physical AI platforms. Her work includes NVIDIA Omniverse, Cosmos and Isaac robotics platforms, including Isaac GR00T for humanoid robot development.

 Madison Huang's education
Madison holds an MBA in Marketing and Strategy from London Business School . Her LinkedIn profile also lists education at the London School of Economics and Political Science and MIT Sloan School of Management. Speaking to students, she encouraged them not to worry about following a conventional career path. “You don't need to have a linear career line,” she said.
